title: ci-scope.sh stops mapping an edit to lint/check_unknown_reads_contract.py to the Windows, macOS and guard job flags, which no longer run it
why: Coordinator 03:27 and 03:28 CST Nov 14 (relayed; the lane of #3005 read .github/scripts/ci-scope.sh line 44; unchecked by triage): after #3005 an edit to that lint starts jobs that no longer run it. The #3005 lane chose to keep the mapping out of #3005 (posted on its PR): the extra jobs are harmless (it fails safe) and a head move costs another round and lane lint. It asked for its own step.
source: Replaces triage's 03:28 pick (a sighting on unknown-reads-lint-linux-only): the lane's wish fits better as its own small step. Neighbours: unknown-reads-lint-linux-only (#3005; blockedBy for this step), macos-jobs-gated-by-scope (reads the same file; the two lanes may both edit ci-scope.sh: the later one merges main in).
note: Triage 03:29 CST Nov 14: blockedBy unknown-reads-lint-linux-only (#3005 merged).
